resonance_mappings.lyric_jp: 描いてた未来ってなんだっけな
resonance_mappings.lyric_en: What was the future we used to paint together?
resonance_mappings.speaker: Saki Tenma
resonance_mappings.story_quote_jp: あたし、何にもできなかった間も、時間はどんどん過ぎていって……。全部、奪われていくみたいで……すごく、怖かったの……。
resonance_mappings.story_quote_en: I kept thinking, we should be having classes together instead of this... I should've been with them, but the clock was ticking away while I was in the hospital, unable to do anything... I felt like it was all being taken away from me... I felt... So scared...
resonance_mappings.resonance_commentary: Saki's intense anxiety over lost youth and hospital isolation directly echoes the longing in Jin's opening lyrics about losing track of their shared future.

resonance_mappings.lyric_jp: 雨上がりの一番星が綺麗だったから
resonance_mappings.lyric_en: Because the first star after the rain was so beautiful
resonance_mappings.speaker: Saki Tenma
resonance_mappings.story_quote_jp: （……もう大丈夫だよ。アタシ。 もう焦ったり、怖がったりしなくていいよ） （これからゆっくり、 みんなとの時間を作っていけるから——）
resonance_mappings.story_quote_en: (...Everything will be okay now. No more anxiety. No more being scared. I'll take my time and enjoy every day as it comes. Together, with my friends.)
resonance_mappings.resonance_commentary: The rainy weather that canceled the observatory outing becomes their mock planetarium in the Sekai, symbolizing their star after the rain—a permanent bond that no longer needs to be rushed.

resonance_mappings.lyric_jp: ここからまた始めるんだ ゼロからじゃなく一から
resonance_mappings.lyric_en: We start over from here, not from zero, but from one
resonance_mappings.speaker: Ichika Hoshino
resonance_mappings.story_quote_jp: 私達、本気だよ……。 待たせてごめんね。もう、ひとりじゃないよ……！ 私達を選んで……！
resonance_mappings.story_quote_en: Shiho, we were being serious... I'm sorry for making you wait all this time. You're not alone anymore... I hope you'll have us...
resonance_mappings.resonance_commentary: Leo/need's opening act performance proves their collective resolve to turn professional, stepping forward together as 4 unified musicians from step one.

resonance_mappings.lyric_jp: 響け、僕らの音よ 心の奥まで届け
resonance_mappings.lyric_en: Resonate, our sound—reach deep into our hearts
resonance_mappings.speaker: Shiho Hinomori
resonance_mappings.story_quote_jp: 一歌……っ！ 私、こんな歌い方するの、知らなかった……。 すごい……っ！
resonance_mappings.story_quote_en: Ichika... I didn't know you could sing like that. It was incredible...
resonance_mappings.resonance_commentary: Ichika's raw vocal drive pierces through initial stage fright, creating emotional resonance that reaches Shiho and convinces her to decline STANDOUT's scout offer.
